name: 连贯性分析
description: 测量 text 连贯性 and logical flow consistency.
useCase: Detecting AI text through unnaturally smooth 连贯性
mechanism: 测量 sequential similarity 之间 content segments. AI生成的 text often maintains unnaturally high 连贯性 throughout, while 人类文本 naturally varies.
source: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
parameters: 窗口大小: 自适应, Quantization: 8-64 levels, Metrics: 熵, CV, 相关性
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI生成的 text
- Language-agnostic 统计 approach
- Works with any text length
- Low computational overhead
limitations:
- Less effective on edited or paraphrased AI text
- Domain-specific content may trigger 误报
- Short texts provide less reliable signals
- Performance varies 跨 写作风格s

references.title: Zellers et al. (2019) - Defending Against Neural Fake News, NeurIPS
Bakhtin, A. et al. (2019). Real or Fake? Learning to Discriminate Machine from Human Generated Text. arXiv.
Guo, B. et al. (2023). How Close is ChatGPT to Human Experts? Comparison Corpus, Evaluation, and Detection. arXiv.
